HACKATHON GUARDRAILS (non-negotiable):
- DEADLINE: 2026-10-12T18:25Z. Feature freeze 2026-10-12T06:25Z. You work on ONE task; stop when its acceptance passes.
- Read docs/DESIGN.md sections named in your task before writing code. src/types.ts is the shared contract:

F17: parse pasted repo refs, per-key token bucket, POST /api/review

web/lib/try.ts parses https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>(.git)?(/)? and
<owner>/<repo>, rejecting other hosts, schemes, extra segments, queries,
fragments and names outside GitHub's allowed characters. createLimiter is a
per-key token bucket with continuous refill, caller-supplied time (so it is
deterministic in tests) and bounded key memory.

web/app/api/review/route.ts validates the body, then rate-limits per client
from x-forwarded-for: 400 invalid, 429 limited, 200 {cached, path} when
public/data/r/<owner>/<repo>/review.json exists, else 202 {queued}. Writing
that cache file is a later task; this route only reports the repo as queued.
